name: hex-mind
description: H.E.X Mind (Hivemind Execution X): an agent-native IDE with live multi-agent observability

scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory apps/backend run alembic upgrade head
scripts.gen:events: uv --directory apps/backend run python -m app.events.export_schema ../desktop/src/renderer/src/generated/events.schema.json && json2ts --input apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/generated/events.schema.json --output apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/generated/events.ts --bannerComment "/* Generated from the backend event schema (apps/backend/app/events/schema.py). Do not edit; run: npm run gen:events */"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hexmind/desktop && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint:backend: uv --directory apps/backend run ruff check . && uv --directory apps/backend run ruff format --check .
